text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Even I didn't expect my blood to boil quite this much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And yet, as if a weight has been lifted, my heart feels completely clear—
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing you run today

text_block_list.text:
Let us fulfill those expectations.
Today, I shall show them all.
